items.title: 18.8.2 Sex Linked Disorders in Humans (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of sex-linked disorders, block for block; the book's problem is a self-check with a drawn Punnett square (PDF 108-110).

blocks.text: Haemophilia aik kam milne wali X-linked recessive khasiyat (bimari) hai. Is bimari mein chot lagne ke baad khoon theek se nahi jamta (clot nahi hota). Is ki wajah khoon jamane wale factors (clotting factors) ka kam hona, theek kaam na karna ya maujood hi na hona hai. Haemophilia ki teen qismein hain: A, B aur C.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat)
blocks.text: Mardon ke Y chromosome par aik khaas gene hai jise SRY (Sex-determining Region Y) kehte hain. Yeh aik protein banata hai jo testes (khusiye) ki nashonuma shuru karta hai aur maada ke tolidi dhaanchon (female reproductive structures) ki nashonuma rokta hai.
Haemophilia A aur B khoon jamane wale factors VIII aur IX ki kharabi se hoti hain. Yeh dono X-linked recessive hain, is liye mardon mein auraton se zyada hoti hain.
Haemophilia C khoon jamane wale factor XI ki kharabi se hoti hai. Yeh autosomal recessive hai, is liye mardon aur auraton dono mein barabar hoti hai.

blocks.caption: Haemophilia ki qismein
rows: Autosomal recessive; dono jinson mein barabar

blocks.prompt: Do normal walidain ka bachcha haemophiliac hai. Walidain ke genotypes kya ho sakte hain? Cross ka Punnett square banayein.
blocks.explanation: Maa carrier XᴴXʰ aur baap normal XᴴY. Punnett square ke chaar bachche: XᴴXᴴ (normal beti), XᴴY (normal beta), XᴴXʰ (carrier beti) aur XʰY (haemophiliac beta). Is liye haemophiliac bachcha beta hai (XʰY), aur us ka Xʰ maa se aaya. Normal baap (XᴴY) ki koi beti haemophiliac nahi ho sakti, kyunke har beti ko baap ka Xᴴ milta hai.

answer_figure.alt: Punnett square: carrier maa (XᴴXʰ) ke gametes Xᴴ aur Xʰ baen taraf, normal baap (XᴴY) ke gametes Xᴴ aur Y oopar. Khane: XᴴXᴴ normal beti, XᴴY normal beta, XᴴXʰ carrier beti, XʰY haemophiliac beta.
answer_figure.caption: Jawab ka diagram (pehle khud banayein, phir milayein): carrier maa (XᴴXʰ) × normal baap (XᴴY) ka Punnett square
answer_figure.long_description: Oopar 'Mother: carrier (XᴴXʰ) × Father: normal (XᴴY)'. Grid ke oopar baap ke gametes Xᴴ aur Y, baen taraf maa ke gametes Xᴴ aur Xʰ. Pehli qatar: XᴴXᴴ (Normal daughter), XᴴY (Normal son), hare rang mein. Doosri qatar: XᴴXʰ (Carrier daughter) naranji rang mein, XʰY (Haemophiliac son) gulabi rang mein. Neeche: haemophiliac bachcha XʰY beta (bachchon ka 1/4); walidain: maa XᴴXʰ, baap XᴴY.

blocks.title: Khoon jamne ka normal tareeqa (Coagulation)
blocks.text:
Khoon jamna aik pecheeda amal hai jo chot lagne par zyada khoon behne se bachata hai. Is ke marahil yeh hain:
1. Chot lagne par platelets chot ki jagah chipak kar platelet plug banate hain.
2. Activated (fa'al) platelets aur zakhmi tissue clotting factors chhorte hain.
3. Clotting factors chemical reactions ka silsila (clotting cascade) chalate hain, jis mein ghulne wala (soluble) protein fibrinogen na ghulne wale (insoluble) protein fibrin mein badal jata hai.
4. Fibrin jaal jaisa dhaancha banata hai jo khoon ke hisson ko phansa kar thos lothra (clot) bana deta hai.
5. Fibrin ke dhagon ke aapas mein jurne (cross-linking) se clot mazboot ho jata hai.
Agar khoon jamne ke nizam ka tawazun bigar jaye to khoon ghair maamooli tareeqe se jamne lagta hai; ise thrombosis kehte hain. Is se stroke aur heart attack (dil ka daura) jaise sangeen masail ho sakte hain.

Normal nazar (trichromatic vision) walon ki aankh ke retina mein teen qisam ke cone cells hote hain, har aik aik bunyadi (primary) rang ke liye hassas: surkh ke liye, hare ke liye aur neele ke liye. Har qisam mein apne pigment proteins hote hain jinhein opsins kehte hain. Surkh aur hare opsins ke genes X chromosome par hain, jab ke neele opsin ka gene autosome 7 par hai. Opsins ke recessive alleles colour-blindness paida karte hain. Is ki qismein yeh hain:

blocks.alt: Aik hi chhe rangon (surkh, naranji, peela, hara, neela, jamni) ki paanch khari pattiyan, jaise woh normal nazar (trichromacy), green-blindness (deuteranopia), red-blindness (protanopia), blue-blindness (tritanopia) aur red-green blindness (blue-cone monochromacy) mein nazar aate hain. Rang-andhe pan wali pattiyon mein kuch rang badal jate ya aik jaise lagte hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.18: Dichromacy aur monochromacy (kitab ki Figure 18.18 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Dichromacy: do bunyadi rang nazar aate hain aur teesra rang, jis ka opsin nahi, nazar nahi aata. Yeh surkh-andha pan (protanopia), hara-andha pan (deuteranopia) ya neela-andha pan (tritanopia) ho sakta hai.

Monochromacy (mukammal colour blindness): sirf aik rang nazar aata hai aur woh do rang nazar nahi aate jin ke opsins nahi. Blue-cone monochromacy mein surkh aur hare opsins nahi hote. Red-cone monochromacy aur green-cone monochromacy bohat kam hoti hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne chhapa hai ke blue-cone monochromacy ko red-green colour-blindness bhi kehte hain. Yeh sahi nahi: red-green colour-blindness un aam X-linked soorton ka naam hai jin mein sirf surkh ya hara opsin ghayab ya kharab ho (protanopia, deuteranopia aur un ki halki soorten); blue-cone monochromacy aik alag, kam milne wali haalat hai.

Colour blindness ka koi ilaaj (cure) nahi. Lekin madadgar technology, jaise colour-blind ainak aur khaas software, rangon mein farq karne mein madad deti hai. Kuch colour-blind log rang pehchanne ki tarbiyat (training) se bhi kamyab hue hain.

30 se zyada bimariyan muscular dystrophies kehlati hain; in mein Duchenne muscular dystrophy sab se aam hai. Yeh X-linked recessive hai, is liye mardon mein zyada hoti hai. Taqreeban do tihai (2/3) cases maa se aate hain aur aik tihai (1/3) nayi mutation se. Jis mard ko is ka recessive allele mile woh muscle protein (dystrophin) nahi bana sakta. Is se muscle fibres mar jate hain aur skeletal muscles kamzor ho kar toot te hain, khaas taur par koolhon (hips), pelvis, raanon (thighs) aur pindliyon (calves) ke. Phir yeh kandhon, gardan, baazuon, saans aur dil ke muscles aur doosre hisson tak phail jati hai.

Muscular dystrophy taqreeban chaar saal ki umr mein bachche ko mutasir karti hai aur jab bachcha chalna shuru karta hai tab nazar aati hai. 10 saal ki umr tak bachche ko braces (taangon ke sahare) chahiye ho sakte hain. 12 saal tak zyada tar mareez chal nahi sakte aur wheelchair chahiye hoti hai. Aam umr 15 se 45 saal hoti hai.

Muscular dystrophy ka ilaaj (cure) nahi, lekin alamaat qaboo karne aur zindagi behtar karne ke tareeqe hain: physical therapy se taqat, lachak aur chalne phirne ki salahiyat qaim rakhi jati hai; corticosteroid dawaen thori muddat ke liye muscles ki taqat behtar karti hain; dard ki dawaen muscles ka dard kam karti hain; aur surgery se jorron ke khinchao (joint contractures) theek kiye jate hain.

blocks.alt: Paanch chhoti tasweerein: ghutnon par haath rakh kar jhuka bachcha (muscle weakness), phooli hui pindli (calf) wali taang (abnormal calf muscles), takiye par leta shakhs (fatigue), panjon par khari taangein (walking on toes) aur phephre (breathing problems).
blocks.caption: Figure 18.19: Muscular dystrophy ki alamaat (symptoms) (kitab ki Figure 18.19 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Haemophilia A (factor VIII) aur B (factor IX) X-linked recessive; C (factor XI) autosomal recessive.
Normal clotting: platelet plug, clotting factors, fibrinogen se fibrin ka jaal, mazboot clot.
Surkh aur hare opsin genes X par, neele ka autosome 7 par; dichromacy aur monochromacy.
Duchenne muscular dystrophy: dystrophin nahi banta; taqreeban 4 saal par alamaat, 12 tak aksar wheelchair.
